configuration.cohorts: One exact identity per row; fixed cohort per track/target/fold, shared by every predictor combination
configuration.estimator: Additive OLS with intercept; no interactions or regularization
configuration.final_refit: All eligible labels available strictly before 2018; fixed-horizon labels require window end <=2018. Lifetime labels rebuilt as of 2018.
configuration.final_test: All validation winners and rankings locked before evaluating any candidate on the 2018+ population; every eligible candidate then receives evaluation metrics
configuration.horizon_26: [debut, debut + 182 days); global source endpoint must reach exclusive window end; V1 definitions unchanged
configuration.lifetime_caution: Eligibility is a selected mature/inactive cohort; unobserved future returns remain possible. Historical eligibility never uses events after that cutoff.
configuration.matched_v1_refit: Selected 26-week winners also refit on the exact V1 pre-2010 training cohort for an identical-training comparison
configuration.observed_lifetime: Observed chart history strictly before each label cutoff; not true completed careers
configuration.overlap_flags: Descriptive flags only; overlapping eligible predictors remain enumerated. No current-song future outcomes are predictors.
configuration.prediction_moment: After publication of first observed chart for exact original title/full artist credit
configuration.preprocessing: Training-only median imputation without missing flags; numeric standardization; training-observed categories and multilabel vocabulary; remove constant encoded columns but retain their conceptual combinations
configuration.retrospective_authorization: User explicitly requested strict campaign plus retrospective sensitivity
configuration.selection: Equal-period mean training-mean-relative MSE skill over three rolling validation folds; then fewer original variables; then lexicographic predictor tuple
configuration.source: Supplied Billboard snapshot, reported upstream mhollingshead/billboard-hot-100; no independent verification
configuration.uncertainty: Paired fixed-prediction resampling by exact full artist credit and debut year; excludes model-selection/refit uncertainty
configuration.unknown_categories: All-zero categorical block; unsupported rows reported
configuration.variable_count: One original construct per variable; season sine/cosine together; categorical or multilabel blocks count as one
